letter_date.description: The date the letter was issued, as printed at the top

office_location.description: The office location given in the body of the letter, as one line

phone.description: The employer's phone number from the letterhead

signatory_title.description: The title of the person who signed the letter, e.g. 'Executive Manager'

contact_email.description: The contact email printed beneath the signature

employee.description: The employee whose employment is being certified

name.description: The employee's full name, without any title such as 'Mr.'

employee_id.description: The employee ID, exactly as printed

employed_since.description: The date employment began, as printed

designation.description: The employee's current designation or job title

currently_employed.description: True if the letter certifies that the person is currently employed

residential_address.description: The employee's residential address as per the employer's records, as one line

purpose.description: What the letter states it is issued for
